Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>
Date: Sat, 07 Nov 2026 13:22:00 -0800
Subject: HelixMart post-incident packet & remedial commitments

Hi Alex,

Attached is our initial RCA packet for the incident on Nov 6 that impacted HelixMart inference latency and elevated 5xxs.

Summary:
- Root cause: KV cache inconsistency during a rare autoscaling transition combined with a regression in kernel selection heuristics for long context sequences.
- Impact: Intermittent latency spikes (p99 from 220ms -> 1.8s) and elevated error rate on heavy batch paths for ~90 minutes.
- Mitigation we applied: rolled back kernel change, forced cache warmup, increased autoscale headroom for HelixMart dedicated pool.

Files attached:
- helixmart_rca_v1.pdf (pdf) - detailed timeline, logs, and trace snippets
- support_log_snippets.txt (txt) - selected log windows and request ids
- remediation_timeline.xlsx (xlsx) - proposed fixes and owners

Immediate asks:
1) Please confirm a safe window for the planned patch deployment next Tue (Nov 10).
2) Share any additional customer logs or error IDs you want included.

We're committed to a full follow-through and will provide a one-page executive summary for your leadership. I'll loop in Vivek to confirm SLA credit calculations.

Thanks,
Priyom
Priyom Das
Senior Manager, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

Priyom,

Thanks for the packet. This was a severe degradation for us — our checkout pipeline saw 30% drop in throughput and the ops team fielded multiple SEVs.
Tom (cc'd) asked that this be escalated to your exec team: we need assurance on timelines and concrete SLA credit calculations. The initial RCA is helpful but we need:
- A firm date when the kernel heuristic will be retired or guarded.
- A guarantee that autoscale headroom will be sufficient for our Black Friday window.
- A written SLA credit proposal.

Please escalate and get back by EOD Monday. We appreciate the quick mitigations but need executive attestation.

Alex
Alex Carroll
Head of Platform
HelixMart

Hi Alex and Tom,

I heard you — escalating now and owning the delivery cadence. Short summary of commitments and owners from Redwood:

- Short term (next 72 hours)
  * Guarded rollback of the kernel heuristic for HelixMart pool — Owner: Engineering, Vivek Kulkarni — Target: Nov 10 02:00-04:00 PT (canary 02:00-02:30).
  * Autoscale headroom bump to +30% for dedicated pool — Owner: Platform Ops, Kimberly Park — Target: Nov 9 06:00 PT.
  * Formal SLA credit calc: Laura Bennett will run final numbers once we confirm window and impacted token counts — deliverable: Nov 9 EOD.

- Medium term (2–3 weeks)
  * Root-cause patch with a robust heuristic test harness and additional monitoring alerts — Owner: Runtime Reliability, Vivek — target: Nov 24.
  * Pre-Black Friday stress test and capacity reservation walkthrough with HelixMart — Owner: Customer Success Engineering, Kimberly — schedule: week of Nov 16.

- Communications
  * Executive one-pager for Tom and HelixMart execs with timeline and credit proposal — Owner: Priyom — draft by Nov 9 10:00 PT. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/01HelixMart/rca-packet

Credit proposal (preliminary): we will offer a one-time service credit equivalent to 8 hours of dedicated pool throughput at agreed committed capacity (detailed calc in attached remediation_timeline.xlsx). Laura will confirm exact figure.

Next steps:
1) Alex/Tom — confirm the maintenance window availability for Nov 10 02:00-04:00 PT.
2) Kimberly and Vivek — please confirm owners and post updates in the Drive folder.
3) Laura — drop the SLA calc and final credit number by Nov 9 EOD.

We will treat this with exec oversight; I've looped in Vivek for delivery. If acceptable, we'll issue a formal DocuSign addendum for the credit and deployment schedule.

Regards,
Priyom
